int canFlow[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

int dr[4] = {-1,1,0,0};
int dc[4] = {0,0,-1,1};

struct Edge {
    int from, to, capacity, flow;
};

int nodeCount, source, sink;
int level[MAXNODE], nextEdge[MAXNODE], queueArr[MAXNODE];
vector<Edge> edges;
vector<int> adj[MAXNODE];

void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity) {
    edges.push_back({from, to, capacity, 0});
    adj[from].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
    edges.push_back({to, from, 0, 0});
    adj[to].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
}

bool makeLevelGraph() {
    int head = 0, tail = 0;
    queueArr[tail++] = source;
    memset(level, -1, nodeCount * sizeof(level[0]));
    level[source] = 0;
    while (head < tail && level[sink] == -1) {
        int v = queueArr[head++];
        for (int id : adj[v]) {
            int to = edges[id].to;
            if (level[to] == -1 && edges[id].flow < edges[id].capacity) {
                queueArr[tail++] = to;
                level[to] = level[v] + 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return level[sink] != -1;
}

int sendFlow(int v, int pushed) {
    if (pushed == 0) return 0;
    if (v == sink) return pushed;
    for (int &i = nextEdge[v]; i < (int)adj[v].size(); ++i) {
        int id = adj[v][i];
        int to = edges[id].to;
        if (level[to] != level[v] + 1) continue;
        int got = sendFlow(to, min(pushed, edges[id].capacity - edges[id].flow));
        if (got) {
            edges[id].flow += got;
            edges[id ^ 1].flow -= got;
            return got;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int maxFlow() {
    int answer = 0;
    while (makeLevelGraph()) {
        memset(nextEdge, 0, nodeCount * sizeof(nextEdge[0]));
        while (int pushed = sendFlow(source, INF))
            answer += pushed;
    }
    return answer;
}
